module.purpose: Provides the floating composer used when a comment placement exists but its thread has not yet been created. It preserves drafts, creates the thread and first comment on submission, and dismisses the pending placement without losing unfinished text.
module.summary: This React component coordinates pending comment placement with editor state, draft persistence, responsive positioning, mention-picker interaction, and comment creation. It renders either the full composer or a host-provided fallback based on permission, keeps the draft synchronized on every edit, dismisses on outside interaction, and returns the editor to selection after a successful post from an idle comment-tool state.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative canvas commenting by turning a placed pin or region into a persisted discussion thread. Failure can lose a user's draft, leave an orphaned placement, or prevent comments from being posted.
functions: stop (~L29-29): Stops pointer and context-menu events from propagating.
PendingComposer (~L35-158): Composes, persists, positions, and submits pending canvas comments.

contractsConsumed.name: CommentMutation
contractsConsumed.shape: commitCommentMutation(editor, ({ put }) => { const pageId = editor.getCurrentPageId(); const thread = createCommentThread({ pageId, anchor: pending.anchor, createdBy: currentUserId }); const comment = createComment({ threadId: thread.id, pageId, authorId: currentUserId, body: text }); put([thread, comment]); return comment })

detail.name: PendingComposer
detail.signature: export function PendingComposer({ editor, pending, currentUserId, resolveAuthor, onPostComment, getMentionSuggestions, renderMentionSuggestion, }: CommentingContext & { editor: Editor; pending: PendingComment })
preconditions: pending contains an anchor and point usable for positioning and comment-thread creation.
postconditions: A valid submission creates and stores a comment thread and comment using the pending anchor, current page, current user, and composer text.

After a successful submission, the local composer text is reset, the new-comment draft is cleared, the pending composer is dismissed, and the select tool is restored when the editor is in comment.idle.
The optional onPostComment callback is invoked after posting cleanup.
invariants: Composer text changes are persisted to the NEW_COMMENT_DRAFT draft.
Clicking outside the composer or its portaled mention popup dismisses the pending composer without discarding the saved draft.
The composer is disabled for submission when the text is empty or no current user ID exists.
A missing resolved author is replaced with UNKNOWN_COMMENT_AUTHOR.
The composer is positioned from editor.pageToViewport(pending.point), with mobile placement behavior applied.
edgeCases: When NEW_COMMENT_DRAFT has no saved value, the composer starts with EMPTY_COMMENT.
When the text is empty, submission returns without creating records or dismissing the pending composer.
When currentUserId is absent, the composer renders as non-submittable and submission returns without creating records.
When canComment is false, the fallback component is rendered if configured; otherwise the composer container has no fallback child.
Pressing Escape dismisses the composer unless the mention picker is open.
Clicking inside the composer or an element matching .tlui-cmt-mention-popup does not dismiss it.
If the optional post callback throws, the callback exception propagates after posting cleanup has completed.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Empty text or a missing current user ID causes submission to return without side effects.
